name: Thomas Massie
statement: Said Biden would likely get no more 'blank checks' for Ukraine this term and that he and fellow Rules Committee members would try to separate Ukraine aid from must-pass spending bills (as reported by Breitbart)

name: Rand Paul
statement: Joined Sanders and Grassley on the Audit the Pentagon Act of 2023: a Defense Department component that fails to get a clean audit opinion would have to return 1 percent of its budget to the Treasury

name: Bernie Sanders
statement: Led the bipartisan Audit the Pentagon Act of 2023 with Paul and Grassley: components without a clean audit opinion return 1 percent of their budgets for deficit reduction

name: Ro Khanna
statement: With Sanders, urged a No vote on the FY2020 NDAA conference report, saying Congress missed a chance to end endless wars and did little to curb military spending

name: Ro Khanna
statement: Cast the lone No vote on the FY2024 NDAA in the House Armed Services Committee, saying too much defense money goes to contractors that raise prices

name: Mark Pocan
statement: Introduced the Audit the Pentagon Act with Rep. Biggs: components that fail to receive an audit opinion forfeit part of their budget authority

name: Andy Biggs
statement: Introduced an amendment with Pocan requiring an annual Pentagon audit and a 0.5% budget cut for components that fail it; it was not allowed a vote

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
statement: Voted No on final passage of the FY2026 NDAA, calling funding of foreign aid and foreign wars 'America Last'; earlier amendments she offered to bar Ukraine funds in defense bills failed (as reported)

name: Josh Hawley
statement: With Sen. Warren, introduced the Prioritizing the Warfighter in Defense Contracting Act to restrict stock buybacks, dividends and high executive pay at major defense contractors that miss Pentagon performance standards

name: Elizabeth Warren
statement: With Sen. Hawley, introduced the Prioritizing the Warfighter in Defense Contracting Act to restrict stock buybacks, dividends and high executive pay at major defense contractors that miss Pentagon performance standards
